market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI is ~$101.79 on May 4 with the Iran/Strait of Hormuz supply shock still elevating prices (touched ~$106 May 1). To hit a $110 HIGH any time in May, WTI needs ~+8% from spot. With ~27 days remaining and ongoing geopolitical tail-risk (potential Hormuz disruption recurring), this is plausible but not a sure thing — a sustained ceasefire could cap upside.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Trajectory of US-Iran ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz reopening timeline.
